integrity: The endpoint estimate is proved directly from the exact telescoping iterate formula and a self-contained discrete weak fractional-tail estimate. Published sources are used for the strong subendpoint classification and the strong endpoint failure. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for Arnold's explicit extremal positive weighted backward shift. It does not assert a weak endpoint for every p-absolutely Cesàro bounded operator. The weak-endpoint constant is not optimized.
title: Weak-\(L^{q_0}\) endpoint for the extremal Cesàro self-improvement shift
